It now points at #6075 (tracking) and #5392 (its blocker) instead of a dead route. Prose-only: no $schema arm, no URL, OBJECTUI_STRUCTURAL_KEYS untouched, corpus untouched. check-changeset-presence.mjs was run BEFORE writing anything and its verdict decided the changeset (it failed the diff, and names the empty-frontmatter declaration as a pass rather than a workaround), so an empty-frontmatter changeset is included.",
```json
  "tests": "All at the final commit 084de8aad (worktree ../objectui-6074, base 575b71c85, git status --porcelain empty so every run below is on byte-identical content). ABLATION re-run first-hand because the new comment asserts it, on examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/plugin-view/object-view-record-surface.json: baseline 309; leg A injected \"$schema\": \"https://objectui.org/schema/v1/schema.json\" -> 309, UNMOVED; leg B (positive control) injected \"className\": \"\" -> 308, moved by exactly 1. BUILD/MUTATION DISCIPLINE for the ablation: the CLI bundle was rebuilt from source before the baseline (`pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli build`, exit 0) and never touched again, which is sound here because the mutation is corpus JSON read at runtime, not code compiled into dist/ — so no per-leg rebuild was owed. Each mutation was confirmed ON DISK before any result was read, and not by the editing tool's exit code: `grep -c` on the injected text returned 1 and `git diff --numstat` returned '1 0' on the target path for both legs; baseline greps were 0. The script carried `trap 'git checkout -- $F' EXIT INT TERM`; both restore legs verified with grep back to 0 and an empty `git status --porcelain` for that path, and the final tree showed only packages/cli/src/commands/check.ts modified. GATES: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/src/__tests__/ --maxWorkers=2` from the repo ROOT (never package-scoped — assertCanonicalVitestInvocation refuses a package cwd) -> 'Test Files 11 passed (11) / Tests 208 passed (208)', VITEST_EXIT=0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli type-check` -> exit 0 and the run echoed '> tsc --noEmit', so it is not a zero-match silent pass. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli lint` (eslint src) -> exit 0, '11 problems (0 errors, 11 warnings)', none in check.ts; 34 files linted counted from --format json, check.ts 0 errors / 0 warnings. node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs -> before: exit 1, 'ERROR 1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change adds no changeset'; after: exit 0, 'OK ... declares 1 changeset(s): .changeset/6074-check-ts-stale-migration-comment.md. Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter'. check-changeset-no-major.mjs -> 'OK No changeset declares a major bump.' check-changeset-fixed.mjs -> 'OK All workspace packages are in the changeset fixed group.' check-control-bytes.mjs -> 'OK (scanned 5027 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)' — 5027 versus 5026 before the commit, so the new changeset is inside the scanned set; both touched files also self-scanned clean with grep -naP on the control-byte class. The four node gates plus the presence gate were re-run at the final commit 084de8aad, after it. DECLARED NARROWING: repo-wide `pnpm lint` (turbo run lint, every package) was not run locally — CI runs the farm regardless. It is a measurement, not a skip: eslint.config.js configures no type-aware linting (zero hits for parserOptions / projectService / project:), so a comment-only edit inside one file of one package cannot move any untouched file's verdict, and the package containing that file was linted in full (34 of 34 files). LIMIT, stated because the card asks for it: this change is prose. No gate catches a false comment and none will keep the corrected one true — the gates above only establish that behaviour, output and the skipped-file count did not change.",
  "open_questions": [],
  "out_of_scope_findings": []
}
```

### Evidence that the corrected comment agrees with the code in the same file

1. **The block twenty lines above, unchanged on `main`:** `⛔ There is deliberately NO $schema arm, and no ObjectUI $schema URL exists to declare.` … `Because that matching was host-based rather than literal, the arm can be added later without invalidating a single file — most soundly once @object-ui/types ships a generated JSON Schema, which is filed separately.`
2. **The mechanism is gone from the tree:** `grep -rn "OBJECTUI_SCHEMA_URL\|pointsAtObjectUi" packages/ examples/ scripts/ docs/` exits 1 with zero matches. #5334's merged body says the same verbatim — *"`pointsAtObjectUi()` and the `OBJECTUI_SCHEMA_URL` constant are gone, along with the branch that called them. What remains is one arm."*
3. **The skip-hint comment below, also unchanged:** `previous revision of this line advised declaring a $schema URL — an arm the 2026-08-20 ruling removed`.

⛔ Assignee untouched · corpus untouched · `OBJECTUI_STRUCTURAL_KEYS` untouched · no `$schema` arm, no URL minted · PR left as **draft**, not marked ready, auto-merge not enabled. CI convergence is the PM's to verify; branch pushed and worktree removed.
